_instructions.background_url: Set an HTTPS GitHub JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, or M4V URL for the library screen.
_instructions.key_background_url: Set an HTTPS GitHub JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, or M4V URL for the key screen.
_instructions.logo: Set an HTTPS GitHub image, GIF, or short-video URL used as the fallback library icon.
_instructions.icon_url: Each library can use its own live HTTPS GitHub image, GIF, or short-video icon.
_instructions.download_url: Set the HTTPS GitHub URL of the native .so library.
_instructions.sha256: Replace the zeros with the exact 64-character SHA-256 digest of the .so file.
_instructions.enabled: Set true only after download_url, icon_url, lib_name, and sha256 are configured.
